market.rules_primary: If the number of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 20 from Sep 28, 2026 to Oct 4, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary: The total is calculated by summing daily counts from Sep 28, 2026 to Oct 4, 2026. The market will resolve no earlier than Tuesday at 9 AM following the end of the period, once complete data is available.
market.title: Will there be more than 20 transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz from Sep 28, 2026 to Oct 4, 2026?
